description: In chain_walk for i>0: step (a) reject anyPolicy as issuer/subject domain in PolicyMappings. Step (b) remap expected_policy_set when policy_mapping>0, delete nodes when policy_mapping==0. Step (h) decrement explicit_policy/policy_mapping/inhibit_any for non-self-issued certs. Steps (i,j) clamp counters from PolicyConstraints and InhibitAnyPolicy extensions.
title: Implement RFC 5280 §6.1.4(a-b,h-j): PolicyMappings + counter updates
